findings.passage: I support individual freedom, limited government, prudency in spending, free markets without government interference or government subsidies, a strong national defense, our rights shall not be infringed, and the National Firearms Act of 1934 must be repealed.
findings.note: Her written statement on the voter-guide profile for the 2026 general election (Mesa Public Schools Governing Board race). The answer itself is undated; the date given is only the election date on the page. She calls for repeal of the National Firearms Act of 1934.

findings.passage: Your 2A rights should not end because you are at work. However, from listening to experts and law enforcement, the best method to not have a school shooting is have metal detectors (which I voted for and we have in my district).
findings.note: Her answer on the voter guide to the statement that licensed, trained faculty should be allowed to carry guns at school, to which she answered 'Strongly Agree'. She adds that she voted for metal detectors in her district. Answer undated; the date is the election date on the page.

findings.passage: Legal residents of the United States should be allowed to own any firearms and ammunition
findings.note: Her written answer on the voter-guide profile for the 2024 general election (Corporation Commissioner race) to 'What restrictions on gun ownership are needed to protect public safety?'. She also answered 'Yes' to 'Should teachers be allowed to carry guns at school?'. Answer undated; the date is the election date on the page. The text has no closing full stop on the page.
subjects: limits on who may own a gun
